recipients.name: Burkor
recipients.hint: Burkor keeps guard in the tower just south east of the Gnomeball field.

recipients.name: Brimstail
recipients.hint: Brimstail has a cave in the Western side of the Stronghold.

recipients.name: Captain Errdo
recipients.hint: Captain Errdo is the gnome pilot stationed upstairs.

recipients.name: Gnome Coach
recipients.hint: You'll find Coach by the Gnomeball pitch, unsurprisingly.

recipients.name: Dalila
recipients.hint: Dalila is sitting in the gnome restaurant with her long-suffering husband.

recipients.name: Damwin
recipients.hint: Damwin likes to have a drink with the Gnomeball fans after the match.

recipients.name: Eebel
recipients.hint: Eebel lives in a hut in the southern end of the stronghold, near to Brimstail's cave.

recipients.name: Ermin
recipients.hint: Ermin is one of the flax spinners in the South East of the Stronghold.

recipients.name: Femi
recipients.hint: Femi delivers goods to the Stronghold, she can usually be found just outside the Stronghold gates.

recipients.name: Froono
recipients.hint: Froono likes to look down on the Magic trees in the South of the Stronghold.

recipients.name: Guard Vemmeldo
recipients.hint: Guard Vemmeldo is in charge of bank security at the bank in the main part of the Stronghold.

recipients.name: Gulluck
recipients.hint: Gulluck is the local armourer, he's upstairs in the Grand Tree.

recipients.name: Heckel Funch
recipients.hint: Heckel Funch runs the cocktail ingredient shop on the other side of the Grand Tree.

recipients.name: King Narnode Shareen
recipients.hint: The King has a throne in the base of the Grand Tree.

recipients.name: Meegle
recipients.hint: Meegle breeds Terrorbirds, in the big Terrorbird pen to the West of the Village.

recipients.name: Perrdur
recipients.hint: Perrdur is sitting in the gnome restaurant with his domineering wife Dalila.

recipients.name: Rometti
recipients.hint: Rometti is the gnome Master Tailor. His shop of beautiful pastel robes can be found in the North East Corner of the Grand Tree.

recipients.name: Sarble
recipients.hint: Sarble keeps an eye on the toads and the worms near the pond.

recipients.name: Trainer Nacklepen
recipients.hint: Nacklepen is the giant tortoise trainer, he hangs around the tortoise training pen north west of the Grand Tree.

recipients.name: Wurbel
recipients.hint: Wurbel likes to watch the Gnomeball. He always tries to get a good view.

recipients.name: Ambassador Ferrnook
recipients.hint: Ambassador Ferrnook is attempting to get an audience with the King in Varrock.

recipients.name: Ambassador Gimblewap
recipients.hint: Ambassador Gimblewap is conducting negotiations in Ardougne Castle.

recipients.name: Ambassador Spanfipple
recipients.hint: Ambassador Spanfipple is conducting negotiations in the White Knight Castle in Falador.

recipients.name: Brambickle
recipients.hint: Brave Brambickle is off exploring the Northern peaks of Trollweiss Mountain.

recipients.name: Captain Bleemadge
recipients.hint: Captain Bleemadge has the misfortune to be stationed on the top of White Wolf Mountain.

recipients.name: Captain Daerkin
recipients.hint: Captain Daerkin is a gnome pilot, though currently off duty. You should find him somewhere in Al Kharid, he likes to watch a good fight.

recipients.name: Captain Dalbur
recipients.hint: Captain Dalbur is stationed in Al Kharid.

recipients.name: Captain Klemfoodle
recipients.hint: Captain Klemfoodle is stationed on the eastern coast of Karamja.

recipients.name: Captain Ninto
recipients.hint: Captain Ninto is an off duty gnome pilot usually stationed on White Wolf Mountain, he should be found somewhere nearby - probably the closest place that sells beer.

recipients.name: G.L.O. Caranock
recipients.hint: G.L.O Caranock? I'm not sure where he is I'm afraid.

recipients.name: Garkor
recipients.hint: Garkor. How interesting. I thought he was missing after a gnome glider incident. I'm sure I heard some monkeys in the background when he called.

recipients.name: Gnormadium Avlafrim
recipients.hint: Gnormadium is all the way south in the Feldips.

recipients.name: Hazelmere
recipients.hint: I believe Hazelmere has a hut on an Island East of Yanille.

recipients.name: King Bolren
recipients.hint: King Bolren rules the Gnome Tree Village, inside the maze.

recipients.name: Lieutenant Schepbur
recipients.hint: Lieutenant Schepbur commands the Battle Tortoises on the Khazard Battlefield.

recipients.name: Penwie
recipients.hint: Penwie the explorer is investigating the Island of Karamja.

recipients.name: Professor Imblewyn
recipients.hint: Professor Imblewyn is studying human magic in the Mages Guild in Yanille.

recipients.name: Professor Manglethorp
recipients.hint: Professor Manglethorp is visiting some engineers in Keldagrim.

recipients.name: Professor Onglewip
recipients.hint: Professor Onglewip is visiting the Wizards in the Wizards Tower.

recipients.name: Wingstone
recipients.hint: Wingstone the explorer is surveying the Southern half of the Kharidian Desert.
